result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but there are a couple of visible content and layout issues near the lower section and horizontally scrolling carousels.

issues.description: The promotion badge on the second popular restaurant card displays “−0%”, which is nonsensical and looks like a formatting or data error.
issues.suggestion: Replace it with the intended discount value, or hide the badge when the discount is zero.

issues.description: The second popular restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation, leaving its restaurant details inaccessible until the page is scrolled further.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so the final card can scroll fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The category row and fastest-near-you carousel visibly cut off items at the right edge, including a partially visible category pill and restaurant card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional overflow affordance and adequate right-side spacing, or show complete cards within the viewport.
